
---
title: "Dynamic Sleep Chart Dashboard"
output: 
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
    theme: flatly
runtime: shiny
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)

# Load data
sleep_data <- read.csv("Sleep_health_and_lifestyle_dataset.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(sleep_data) <- make.names(colnames(sleep_data))
```

Column {.sidebar}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Select Columns to Visualize

```{r}
selectInput("xcol", "X-axis variable", choices = names(sleep_data), selected = "Age")
selectInput("ycol", "Y-axis variable", choices = names(sleep_data), selected = "Sleep.Duration")
```

Column
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Dynamic Chart

```{r}
renderPlotly({
  xvar <- input$xcol
  yvar <- input$ycol

  req(xvar, yvar)

  plot_ly(
    data = sleep_data,
    x = ~get(xvar),
    y = ~get(yvar),
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "markers",
    marker = list(opacity = 0.6)
  ) %>%
    layout(
      title = paste("Chart of", yvar, "vs", xvar),
      xaxis = list(title = xvar),
      yaxis = list(title = yvar)
    )
})
```
